| hook | 0.1–5.1s | GTA 6 drops November 19th. Here are five things you need to know before you hit play. |
| f1 | 5.3–14.6s | Number one. It unlocks at midnight, your local time. There's no single global launch. So players in New York get in a full three hours before L.A.. West Coast, you're waiting. |
| f2 | 14.8–25.9s | Number two. The download is huge. Rockstar says up to 212 gigabytes, depending on your console. Pre-loading has been open since November 10th, so start it tonight. Not at 11:59. |
| f3 | 26.1–35.6s | Number three. Buying physical? There's no disc in the box. It's just a download code. So you still need the space, and you still need the internet. And the Ultimate Edition? That's digital only. |
| f4 | 35.7–48.0s | Number four. The bonus isn't only for pre-orders. Buy before November 20th and you get the Vintage Vice City Pack. A classic '55 Stanier, a garage, outfits, hairstyles and a weapon pattern. Yes, launch day counts. |
| f5 | 48.2–57.4s | And number five. There's still no PC version announced. But if you're on Xbox One, you're not totally out. Rockstar says you can stream it through Xbox Cloud Gaming. |
| end | 57.6–59.8s | So, are you playing at midnight, or waiting? Let me know. |
